name: inventory-regeneration-context
text:
`scripts/inventory.py` writes one document per crate listing the public items of every source file of that crate, so that a reader sees the crate's surface without opening each file. The document also records the digest of each file the generator read, and `checks/run.sh` compares those digests with the files, so a document that no longer describes the crate is a failing check.

Add `pub fn crate_version() -> &'static str` to `crates/context/src/lib.rs`, returning the crate's version through `env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")`, with a test in `crates/context/src/lib_test.rs` that compares it with the `version` in `crates/context/Cargo.toml`. Then regenerate `crates/context/inventory.toml` with `scripts/inventory.py context`. The inventory lists the public items of every source file of the crate and records the digest of each file it read; `checks/run.sh` compares the digests with the files. An inventory edited by hand does not count as regenerated.

checks/run.sh runs the checks this task is judged on: a type check of foe-context, and the comparison of the digests `crates/context/inventory.toml` records with the files under `crates/context/src`.

Follow AGENTS.md. Run the checks it names. When you finish, or when you cannot, report your outcome.
